title: Resources Game
meta_description: Go out, find deposits, and build your first mine! (GPS multiplayer economy game)
full_description: 🗺️  for resources, and find rich deposits on the map.🛠️  to extract from these deposits, and process the resources into products. 🤑, expand your mining operations and your buildings, and earn rank and name by making the headlines in the NEWS, or upgrade your headquarters to stay ahead of the competition instead.😎  by attacking them and looting additional resources.📦 to recycle, sell or invest into upgrading special buildings.🌎 The game needs* GPS or network location, because you build mines according to the real geo-coordinates of where you are located. (*GPS-based game, geocaching like multiplayer online game)  An active internet connection is required to play. Therefore there may be additional costs and fees, depending on your contract with the network service provider!A network connection speed of > 350Kbps (= min. 3G, 4G or LTE) is recommended👨‍💻 developed during free time The developer is therefore grateful if you do not go too hard on him for any lag or bugs, and instead provide constructive feedback to support and improve the app. :-) The support function within the app should make this as easy as possible.Please show understanding if not all requests can be answered promptly and personally, since no help-desk team exists and the developer's a working family man. ;)You can find more information about the game, including a forum, at http://www.resources-game.ch/en
